note:
R70 - Xbox 360 `RW4xb2` mip-level positions: a stricter, self-contained classifier with independent controls (read-only).

Motivation (coordinator review 2026-09-22, F1): r66's "decisive" predicate compared the best candidate only with the crowd (5th
percentile / median), tested neither a unique optimum nor a runner-up margin nor content informativeness, rounded its decision values and
excluded disagreements after the fact. This probe re-derives the per-level classification from the same descriptors with one rule for
agreements and disagreements alike, keeps every decision value unrounded, and adds controls that do not depend on H1 agreement:

  informativeness  the parent-derived target must vary (block-mean std over a threshold, several distinct block colours) and the candidate
                   crowd must spread (median - p05 over a threshold); otherwise the level is UNINFORMATIVE (never "found");
  ambiguity        the best refined score must beat the best refined score of every other coarse basin by a margin (ratio and absolute),
                   and no other basin may tie it; otherwise AMBIGUOUS;
  misplacement     the score at the found offset +/- one 4 KiB page, +/- one block, and + one level tile must be clearly worse
                   (a control that a *misplaced* level is distinguishable at exactly this record);
  byte order       the same gather with little-endian endpoint words must not beat the big-endian read;
  decoded content  an independent test of the found position: the level's DXT colour blocks are FULLY decoded (palette + 2-bit indices,
                   both X360 index-byte orders tried) and compared texel-by-texel with the 2x2 box reduction of the fully decoded parent;
                   the same at the found offset + one page (a misplacement control on decoded content, not endpoint means).

Only levels that pass all four independent gates are LOCATED; only LOCATED levels are compared with the candidate rule H1 (own align32 tile
per level while min(w,h) > 16 texels, then one packed tail tile with the Xenos texel-offset placement). DXN / CTX1 / 8_8_8_8 / cubes are
skipped and counted, never scored. Synthetic controls (`--synthetic`) run the same classifier on in-memory textures: a constant texture
(must be UNINFORMATIVE), a 2-period repeating texture (must be AMBIGUOUS or UNINFORMATIVE), a noise texture laid out exactly by H1 (must be
LOCATED at H1) and the same with level 2 shifted by one page (must be LOCATED at the shifted offset and disagree with H1).

Usage: python r70_rw4xb2_level_classifier.py <out.json> [--titles nhl09,nhl13] [--per-shape 2] [--max-files 4000] [--synthetic]
Reads the loose `rendering/**/*.rx2` trees only; writes only the JSON named on the command line.

noise_h1_128x128_m6.expect: located at H1 on every level >= 4x4 blocks

noise_h1_128x128_m6_level2_plus_page.expect: level 2 located at H1 + 4096 and h1_agree false
